info.name: V9.2
info.description:
Includes CRUD, field validation and authorization edge cases. Old-token behavior is exploratory unless token expiration/invalidation is explicitly defined by the API contract.

V8: добавлена систематическая проверка соответствия типов данных для полей booking в POST/PUT/PATCH и проверки типов основных полей в успешных response.

item.name: BOOK-GET-010 firstname + lastname + checkin + checkout filters
DEL-LIFE-001 Create booking for delete lifecycle
SETUP Create fresh booking for PUT validation
SETUP Create fresh booking for PATCH validation
PATCH-V035 single valid field; omitted fields allowed
10 Authorization Validation
item.description: Authorization edge cases. oldToken checks are exploratory: a newly issued token does not necessarily invalidate the previous token unless the contract says so.

item.name: AUTH-V001 Save current token as oldToken
AUTH-V002 Re-authenticate and store new token
BOOKING-POST-V001 Create booking for authorization tests
BOOKING-PUT-AUTH-NEW Control: new token is valid

exec: pm.test('New token successfully authorizes update', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
